name: – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission implementing decision renewing the authorisation for placing on the market of products containing, consisting of or produced from genetically modified soybean MON 87769 pursuant to Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission not to renew the permission to sell food and feed made from a genetically modified soybean called MON 87769. This soybean was changed to produce a very different mix of fats in its oil. The Parliament says the original safety review is over ten years old, that the soybean's other nutritional differences were never properly examined, and that no one actually tracked whether people in the European Union ate it.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to withdraw its plan and refuse renewal.
- **Who it affects:** Companies selling this soybean, its oil and feed in the European Union.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to drop or keep its plan.
